description: Bridge Hold Location Stipulations is a dataset listed in City of New York open data portal (data.cityofnewyork.us), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of New York. This dataset provides locations which have the Bridge Hold as one of the stipulations. The information gives the location of all the blocks and the intersections within 100 feet of a Bridge Structure. Coverage: New York City. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are permit, stipulation, bridge, bridge hold map. The table has 15 columns. Attribution on the portal: Department of Transportation (DOT). The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-cityofnewyork-us-portal.
